h1: BambooHR ($10–$22 PEPM + $250/mo Minimum) vs. Rippling Modular HRIS & IT Seat Cost Calculator (2026)
summary: BambooHR transitions from flat per-employee-per-month (PEPM) pricing to a $250/month account minimum below ~20 employees and charges separate add-ons for US Payroll (+$4–$8/emp), Time Tracking (+$3/emp), and Performance Management—making Gusto ($49+$6) or OnPay ($49+$6) cheaper under 30 seats, while Rippling ($8 Core + modular HR/IT apps) wins for unified HRIS + MDM device provisioning.

verdict.winner: Gusto ($49+$6) & OnPay ($49+$6) Win Under 30 Seats; Rippling Wins When Bundling HRIS + IT Device & SSO Seats
verdict.hiddenFeeTrap: BambooHR enforces a ~$250/month minimum floor for small teams and charges extra for Payroll, Time Tracking, and Benefits Administration modules on top of Core/Pro HRIS seats.
verdict.actionLine: Model your exact headcount and multi-state footprint in the PEPM calculator below to compare BambooHR, Rippling, Gusto, and OnPay.

auditNotes: BambooHR $250/Month Minimum Floor: Teams with 8–15 employees paying the $250/mo BambooHR minimum effectively pay $16.67–$31.25 per employee before adding payroll or benefits administration.
Rippling IT & SSO Consolidation Offset: Replacing standalone Jamf/Kandji ($8–$12/device) and Okta ($6–$10/seat) with Rippling IT offsets Rippling Core's $8/seat platform fee.

faq.q: How much does BambooHR cost per employee per month in 2026?
faq.a: BambooHR uses quote-based PEPM tiers typically ranging from $10 to $14/employee/month for BambooHR Core and $16 to $22/employee/month when adding Pro performance management, Time Tracking, and US Payroll, subject to a ~$250/month minimum floor for small teams.

faq.q: Is Rippling or BambooHR cheaper for a 25-person company?
faq.a: For pure HRIS + Payroll at 25 employees, both BambooHR and Rippling run roughly $450 to $580/month ($5,400–$6,960/yr), whereas Gusto Simple ($49 + $6/emp = $199/mo) and OnPay ($49 + $6/emp = $199/mo) cost less than half as much.

faq.q: Does BambooHR charge an implementation or onboarding fee?
faq.a: Yes. Unlike Gusto and OnPay ($0 setup fee), BambooHR typically charges a one-time implementation and data migration fee ranging from $500 to $2,500 depending on headcount and modules.
